newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa retraces to end unchanged.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa retraces to end unchanged.

text.p: CSCE cocoa prices ended near unchanged Wednesday after an early rally to one-month highs was met with heavy trade selling, market sources said.
Speculative short-covering took prices higher early on, but manufacturers and producers met the run-up with heavy selling as May approached the $1,350 range.
"In New York, you had very good selling from the high $1,340s to the low $1,350s," said one trader.
Most-active May futures closed at $1,336, unchanged from the previous day, having traded from $1,326 to $1,352.

Today's late sell-off could set the stage for a more substantial correction when trading resumes on Thursday, traders said. They noted that the market's struture tightened up slightly, with the July contract rising $2, to $1,361.

"It wouldn't surprise me if we fell tomorrow," the trader said. The first major downside target was seen at $1,316, followed by $1,300. Resistance would be fairly tough at $1,353, a breakout point from last month.
An estimated 11,124 lots were traded on the day, compared with 11,897 lots on Tuesday.
((-- W Pollack, New York Commodities Desk +1 212 859 1640))
